description: Non-replacing remote companion (Copilot Lazy Ass) for GitHub Copilot Chat: mirror chatSessions over WebSocket/PWA and inject prompts via workbench chat commands.
cmd.copyWsUrl: Copilot Lazy Ass: Copy PWA URL
cmd.showQr: Copilot Lazy Ass: Show QR Panel
cmd.copyToken: Copilot Lazy Ass: Copy Auth Token
cfg.host: Bind host. Use 127.0.0.1 for local-only; 0.0.0.0 for LAN.
cfg.autoStart: Start bridge when VS Code finishes startup.
cfg.authToken: Optional shared token. If set, clients must send PHONE_CONNECT.token (or ?token= on PWA URL).
cfg.defaultMode: Default chat mode for injected phone messages.
cfg.injectSessionOpen: Injection targeting. 'editor' (default): open the target chat session as ChatEditor, then submit; requires disk verification or clipboard fallback. 'sidebar': also move Chat into the Side Bar (may refocus the wrong widget on 1.131). 'focused-only': inject into whichever chat is focused; may hit the wrong session.
cfg.pollMs: JSONL tail poll interval in ms.
cfg.sessionRescanMs: How often to rescan for the newest chatSessions jsonl.
cfg.liveOnly: If true, start tailing at EOF (only new chat activity). If false, replay the whole session on switch.
cfg.preferTranscript: Use the GitHub.copilot-chat/transcripts realtime event stream as the primary content source (millisecond latency, avoids the ~60s chatSessions state flush lag). Falls back to chatSessions when the transcripts dir is missing.
cfg.enableTunnel: Auto-start a Cloudflare quick tunnel when the bridge starts. If false (default), open the sidebar and click Start Tunnel, or run the Start Tunnel command. The public URL and session token only appear after the tunnel starts.
cfg.downloadCloudflared: If cloudflared is missing, download it once into ~/.copilot-sidecar-companion/.
cfg.tunnelTimeoutMs: Milliseconds to wait for the cloudflared trycloudflare public URL before failing Start Tunnel.
